meals.name: Honey-Garlic Chicken Stir-fry Bowls
meals.description: Quick and flavorful chicken and broccoli stir-fry served over steamed rice, ready in about 35 minutes.
instructions: Step 1: Slice chicken breasts into 1-inch pieces. In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, sesame oil, minced garlic, and grated ginger. In a separate small bowl, whisk cornstarch with water to create a slurry.
Step 2: Heat olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook for 5-7 minutes, until browned and cooked through. Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.
Step 3: Add broccoli florets to the hot skillet. Stir-fry for 3-5 minutes until tender-crisp. Return chicken to the skillet.

Step 4: Pour the sauce mixture over the chicken and broccoli. Bring to a simmer, then stir in the cornstarch slurry. Cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens. Serve immediately over cooked rice.

meals.name: Sheet Pan Lemon Herb Salmon & Asparagus
meals.description: A healthy and easy sheet pan meal featuring tender salmon fillets and roasted asparagus with bright lemon and herbs, ready in under 40 minutes.
instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.

Step 2: Pat salmon fillets dry. Trim the woody ends off the asparagus. On the baking sheet, toss asparagus with 1 tablespoon olive oil, half of the garlic powder, half of the paprika, salt, and pepper.

Step 3: Place salmon fillets on the same baking sheet. Drizzle with remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil. Season salmon with remaining garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Top each fillet with lemon slices and sprinkle with fresh dill.
Step 4: Bake for 12-18 minutes, or until salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork (internal temperature 145°F/63°C) and asparagus is tender-crisp. Serve immediately.

meals.name: Slow Cooker Dr Pepper Pulled Beef Sandwiches
meals.description: Tender, sweet, and savory pulled beef made easily in the slow cooker, perfect for sandwiches, with minimal active cooking time.
instructions: Step 1: Trim any excess fat from the beef chuck roast. Season the roast generously with garlic powder, chili powder, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Step 2: Place sliced yellow onion in the bottom of a 6-quart slow cooker. Add the seasoned beef roast on top of the onions.
Step 3: Pour the can of Dr Pepper and BBQ sauce over the beef. Cover and cook on LOW for 6-8 hours, or on HIGH for 3-4 hours, until the beef is fork-tender and easily shredded.
Step 4: Carefully remove the beef from the slow cooker and shred it using two forks. Return the shredded beef to the slow cooker and stir to coat with the sauce. Serve hot on hamburger buns.

meals.name: Sheet Pan Crispy Chicken Thighs & Roasted Broccoli
meals.description: Crispy-skinned chicken thighs and tender-crisp broccoli roasted together on one pan for an easy and delicious meal in about 40 minutes.
instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Pat chicken thighs thoroughly dry with paper towels.

Step 2: In a small bowl, combine panko bread crumbs, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, oregano, salt, and pepper. Drizzle chicken thighs with 1 tablespoon olive oil, then press the panko mixture onto the skin side of each thigh.

Step 3: Place chicken thighs skin-side up on one half of the baking sheet. Toss broccoli florets with the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt, and pepper, then spread them on the other half of the baking sheet.

Step 4: Roast for 25-30 minutes, or until chicken internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C) and the skin is golden and crispy, and broccoli is tender-crisp with slightly browned edges. Serve immediately.

meals.name: Quick Pork and Cabbage Stir-fry
meals.description: A super-fast and simple stir-fry featuring tender ground pork and crisp cabbage in a savory sauce, on the table in under 30 minutes.
instructions: Step 1: In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil, and rice vinegar. Set aside.

Step 2: Heat olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add ground pork and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Drain any excess fat.
Step 3: Add diced yellow onion, minced garlic, grated ginger, and red pepper flakes (if using) to the skillet with the pork. Stir-fry for 2 minutes until fragrant.

Step 4: Add shredded cabbage to the skillet. Stir-fry for 3-5 minutes until the cabbage starts to wilt but still retains some crunch. Pour the prepared sauce over the pork and cabbage, toss to combine, and cook for another 1-2 minutes until heated through. Serve immediately, optionally over cooked rice.

meals.name: Garlic-Ginger Beef and Broccoli Noodle Skillet
meals.description: A savory and satisfying one-pan noodle skillet with tender beef, crisp broccoli, and a rich garlic-ginger sauce, ready in about 45 minutes.
instructions: Step 1: Slice beef against the grain into thin strips. In a small bowl, whisk together beef broth, soy sauce, and brown sugar. In another small bowl, whisk cornstarch and water to create a slurry.
Step 2: Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add beef strips and cook in batches for 2-3 minutes per side until browned. Remove beef and set aside.

Step 3: Add remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil to the skillet. Add minced garlic and grated ginger, stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant. Add broccoli florets and stir-fry for 3-5 minutes until tender-crisp.

Step 4: Return beef to the skillet. Pour in the broth mixture, bring to a simmer. Add cooked noodles and cornstarch slurry, tossing to coat. Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring, until sauce thickens and noodles are well coated. Garnish with sesame seeds if desired and serve immediately.

meals.name: Roasted Pork Loin with Apples and Sweet Potatoes
meals.description: A comforting and hearty roasted pork loin with tender sweet potatoes and apples, perfect for a family dinner in about 75 minutes.

ingredients.name: apples, cored and diced (e.g., Honeycrisp, Fuji)

instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). In a small bowl, whisk together Dijon mustard, maple syrup, dried thyme, chopped rosemary, 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper.
Step 2: Pat the pork loin dry. Rub the mustard-maple mixture all over the pork loin. Place the pork loin in the center of a large roasting pan or oven-safe dish.

Step 3: In a large bowl, toss diced sweet potatoes, diced apples, chopped yellow onion, and minced garlic with the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper. Arrange the vegetable and fruit mixture around the pork loin in the roasting pan.

Step 4: Roast for 45-60 minutes, or until the internal temperature of the pork loin reaches 145°F (63°C) (checked with a meat thermometer), and the sweet potatoes are tender. Let the pork rest for 5-10 minutes before slicing and serving with the roasted vegetables and apples.
